about: An underground cavern adventure in the Zork tradition. You come down an endless stair after a dream-test from a silver-haired old man. A sword sits in a rock, there is a land of shadows, a hooded figure with a glowing sword, and an underground sea.

done.why: I died on purpose in the quicksand, saw the respawn, and felt I had seen the shape of the place.

ending.what: None reached. I died in the quicksand and was sent back to the stair.

moments.note: The sword from the junction appeared in my hand when the hooded figure showed up.
Death was handled with a prison cell scene and an old man, and the lamp was returned to me.
Polite or oddly phrased commands were not understood.

wished: Know where my scattered items ended up
Have the parser accept looser phrasings

lines.line: You enter the quicksand and slowly sink to a new low in adventuring.
lines.why: A dry joke for a death I caused on purpose.

lines.line: From nowhere, the sword from the junction appears in your hand, wildly glowing!
lines.why: A dramatic surprise that changed what I thought the sword was.

fun.why: Atmospheric and responsive to the odd things I tried, but I only played briefly.

engagement.why: The hooded figure and the old man's setup pulled me in, but I stopped early.

difficulty.why: I barely met any puzzles. Death was gentle and cost little.

interestingness.why: The death sequence and the items scattered along the way in were an unusual touch.

prose.why: Evocative and economical. The cavern descriptions are good.
